setup.en: Set the rack hooks at about upper-chest height, with room above and in front of you. If the empty Olympic bar is too heavy, use a lighter training bar; put collars on any plates.
setup.zh: 把架子挂钩调到大约上胸的高度，头顶和身前要留出空间。空的奥林匹克杠还嫌重，就换一根更轻的训练杠；加了杠片一定要上卡扣。

steps.en: Stand close to the bar and grip it a little wider than your shoulders, thumbs wrapped around it. The bar sits over the heel of your palm, wrists close to straight.
steps.zh: 站到杠前，双手握距比肩稍宽，拇指扣住杠。杠压在掌根上，手腕尽量保持平直。

steps.en: Lift the bar off the hooks and take a short step back. Set your feet about hip-width apart and tighten your stomach so your ribs stay stacked over your pelvis. Elbows sit slightly in front of the bar.
steps.zh: 把杠从挂钩上取下，向后退一小步。双脚约与髋同宽，收紧腹部，让胸廓叠在骨盆正上方。手肘略在杠的前面。

steps.en: Breathe out and press the bar straight up, pulling your chin back just enough for the bar to pass your face. Keep your knees still; do not dip and drive with the legs.
steps.zh: 呼气，把杠竖直向上推，下巴稍往后收，让杠从脸前经过。膝盖不动，不要先下蹲再用腿把杠顶上去。

steps.en: Once the bar passes your forehead, move your head forward under it without arching your back. Finish with arms almost straight and the bar over your shoulders and the middle of your feet; let your shoulder blades turn upward with the arms.
steps.zh: 杠过了额头，头往前回到杠下，腰不要后弓。顶端手臂接近伸直，杠在肩膀和脚掌中部的正上方；肩胛骨随手臂一起上回旋。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the bar slowly along the same close path to your upper chest, pulling your chin back again. Keep your stomach tight; do not let the bar drop onto you.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿同一条贴近身体的路线慢慢把杠放回上胸，下巴再往后收一下。腹部保持收紧，不要让杠砸下来。

steps.en: After the last repetition, hold the bar at your upper chest, walk forward until it touches the uprights, and lower it onto both hooks before letting go.
steps.zh: 最后一次做完，杠停在上胸，向前走到杠贴住立柱，确认落在两边挂钩上再松手。

cues.en: Ribs stay over the pelvis as the hands go up.
cues.zh: 手往上走，胸廓始终叠在骨盆上。

cues.en: Bar close to the face on the way up, then over the middle of the feet.
cues.zh: 杠贴着脸往上走，最后停在脚掌中部的正上方。

cues.en: Feel the front and sides of the shoulders and the backs of the arms working together.
cues.zh: 用力感在肩前侧、肩外侧和上臂后侧。

mistakes.en: Leaning back to get the bar past your face. Why: the low back arches, and the lift turns into a steep incline press instead of an overhead press.
mistakes.zh: 后仰给杠让路。为什么：下背过度弓起，推举变成了大角度的上斜推，而不是举过头顶。

mistakes.en: Holding the shoulder blades down at the top. Why: raising the arms overhead needs the shoulder blades to turn upward; pinning them down blocks the movement.
mistakes.zh: 顶端还把肩胛骨往下压住。为什么：手臂举过头顶需要肩胛骨上回旋，压住它就会卡住动作。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Spreading shoulder work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把肩部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Never press a load you cannot lower back to your chest and re-rack. Learn how to end a failed lift safely before adding weight.
cautions.zh: 不要推放不回胸前、挂不回架子的重量。加重之前，先学会推不动时怎样安全地结束。

cautions.en: Stop at sharp pain in the shoulder, tingling, or a sudden loss of control.
cautions.zh: 肩部刺痛、有发麻感，或突然控制不住杠，立刻停下。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Research shows: 15 healthy men pressed 80 % of their maximum seated and standing, with a barbell and with dumbbells. Front deltoid EMG was about 15 % lower with the standing barbell than with standing dumbbells, but their standing maximum was about 7 % lower with dumbbells than with the barbell.
text.zh: 研究显示：15 名健康男性用各自最大重量的 80 %，分别坐姿、站姿做杠铃和哑铃推举。站姿杠铃比站姿哑铃的三角肌锁骨部（前束）肌电低约 15 %，但站姿哑铃能推的最大重量比杠铃低约 7 %。

text.en: Higher EMG is not proof of more growth: EMG has not been shown to predict how much a muscle grows.
text.zh: 肌电更高不等于长得更多：没有证据表明肌电能预测肌肉增长多少。

name.zh: 哑铃侧平举（手臂稍向前）

setup.en: Choose light dumbbells and give yourself room to open your arms. In this version the arms rise out to the sides and slightly forward, not straight out to the sides.
setup.zh: 选轻哑铃，给张开手臂留出空间。这个版本手臂向侧面、略偏前方抬起，而不是正侧方。

steps.en: Stand tall, feet about hip-width apart, knees soft. Hold the dumbbells beside your thighs, palms facing in.
steps.zh: 站直，双脚约与髋同宽，膝盖放松。哑铃垂在大腿两侧，掌心朝内。

steps.en: Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend all the way. Tighten your stomach a little so your ribs do not lift as the arms rise.
steps.zh: 肘关节微屈，整个动作都保持这个角度。腹部稍微收紧，抬臂时胸廓不要往上翻。

steps.en: Breathe out and lift your upper arms out to the sides and slightly forward, elbows leading. Let your shoulder blades move with the arms instead of squeezing them together.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向侧面、略向前抬起，手肘带着走。肩胛骨跟着手臂自然动，不要刻意夹紧。

steps.en: Stop at about shoulder height, or lower if that is where your comfortable range ends. Hands and elbows are at about the same height, thumbs level or tilted slightly up.
steps.zh: 抬到大约与肩同高；舒服的范围更低，就在更低处停。手和手肘大致一样高，拇指持平或稍微朝上。

steps.en: Pause without shrugging, then breathe in and lower slowly to your sides. Settle your balance before the next repetition.
steps.zh: 停一下，不要耸肩；再吸气，慢慢放回体侧。站稳了再做下一次。

cues.en: Lead with the upper arms; keep the same small elbow bend.
cues.zh: 上臂带着走，肘部的微屈角度不变。

cues.en: Lift only as high as you can lower smoothly.
cues.zh: 只抬到还能平稳放下的高度。

cues.en: Feel it on the outside of the shoulder, with no pinch inside the joint.
cues.zh: 用力感在肩膀外侧，关节里面不应该有夹痛。

mistakes.en: Swinging the hips to throw the dumbbells up. Why: momentum lifts the weight and the shoulders stop controlling it.
mistakes.zh: 摆髋把哑铃甩上去。为什么：重量靠惯性上去，肩膀不再控制它。

mistakes.en: Shrugging before the arms rise. Why: the shoulder hitches up towards the ear instead of the arm lifting out to the side.
mistakes.zh: 手臂还没抬起就先耸肩。为什么：肩膀往耳朵方向提，而不是手臂向侧面抬起。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Sets do not have to go to failure to work.
text.zh: 每组不必练到力竭也有效果。

cautions.en: If one part of the lift hurts, lighten the load or shorten the range; stop if the pain stays.
cautions.zh: 抬到某个角度会疼，就减轻重量或缩小幅度；疼痛不消失就停下。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a firm, non-slip floor. Start with a gentle pike, knees bent if needed, and a shallow depth; even without added weight the floor version is hard.
setup.zh: 在结实、不打滑的地面上做。先做髋部抬得不太高的版本，需要时弯膝，下得浅一些；不加任何重量，地面版本也已经很吃力。

steps.en: Place your hands about shoulder-width apart, fingers spread. Walk your feet back, then lift your hips so your body makes an upside-down V.
steps.zh: 双手约与肩同宽撑地，手指张开。双脚向后走，再把髋部抬高，让身体成一个倒 V 形。

steps.en: Keep your back long and bend your knees if you need to. Look between your hands; push through your whole palm, with your weight on your hands and feet.
steps.zh: 背部保持伸展，需要时弯曲膝盖。眼睛看两手之间，用整个手掌撑地，体重落在手和脚上。

steps.en: Breathe in and bend your elbows back at an angle, lowering the top of your head towards a spot just ahead of your hands. Keep the hips high; do not let it turn into an ordinary push-up.
steps.zh: 吸气，两肘斜向后弯，头顶朝两手前方一点的地面下降。髋部保持高位，不要变成普通俯卧撑。

steps.en: Stop before your head touches the floor, at a depth you can push back from smoothly. Elbows stay angled back, not flared straight out to the sides.
steps.zh: 头碰地之前就停，深度以能平稳推回为准。两肘保持斜向后，不要完全向两侧张开。

steps.en: Breathe out and push the floor away until your arms are nearly straight, letting your shoulder blades turn upward. Keep the same pike shape.
steps.zh: 呼气，把地面推开，直到手臂接近伸直，肩胛骨随之上回旋。身体保持原来的倒 V 形。

steps.en: To finish, lower your knees to the floor with control before lifting your hands.
steps.zh: 结束时，先有控制地把膝盖放到地上，再抬起双手。

cues.en: Hips stay high while the elbows bend.
cues.zh: 屈肘时，髋部始终保持高位。

cues.en: Push through the palms; your head is never a support.
cues.zh: 用手掌推地，头永远不是支撑点。

mistakes.en: Resting on the head at the bottom. Why: the neck takes weight that the arms and feet should carry.
mistakes.zh: 下到最低点用头顶着地撑住。为什么：本该由手臂和双脚承担的体重压到了脖子上。

mistakes.en: Letting the hips drop as you go down. Why: the body flattens towards an ordinary push-up, so the chest takes over more of the push.
mistakes.zh: 下降时髋部跟着掉下来。为什么：身体变得接近普通俯卧撑，推的力量更多转给了胸部。

text.en: Learn to control ordinary push-ups first. Then make the pike harder in small steps (straighter legs, higher hips, a little deeper), only as far as your head stays off the floor.
text.zh: 先把普通俯卧撑做稳。再分小步加难：腿伸得更直、髋抬得更高、下得更深一点，前提是头始终不碰地。

text.en: Sets do not have to go to failure to work.
text.zh: 每组不必练到力竭也有效果。

text.en: Spreading shoulder work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把肩部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: If you cannot keep your head off the floor, go back to ordinary or incline push-ups for now.
cautions.zh: 头总是会碰到地面，就先回去练普通俯卧撑或上斜俯卧撑。

cautions.en: Stop at wrist or shoulder pain, dizziness or loss of balance.
cautions.zh: 手腕或肩部疼痛、头晕或失去平衡时，停下。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

name.zh: 胸托哑铃划船（两肘略外展）

setup.en: Use a stable incline bench and light dumbbells. Keep your elbows moderately away from your sides so the arms move back and out; in this version the back of the shoulder and the upper back share the work.
setup.zh: 用稳固的上斜凳和轻哑铃。两肘与身体保持一定距离，让上臂向后、向外走；这个版本由肩后部和上背部一起出力。

steps.en: Lie chest-down on the sloped pad, feet planted wide enough to balance. Keep your neck in line with your back and your chest on the pad throughout.
steps.zh: 胸口朝下趴在斜凳上，双脚分开踩稳。颈部和背部保持一条线，胸口全程贴着靠垫。

steps.en: Let your arms hang below your shoulders with the dumbbells, palms facing back or slightly in, wrists straight. Let your shoulder blades slide a little forward.
steps.zh: 双臂握住哑铃，从肩下自然垂下，掌心朝后或稍朝内，手腕平直。肩胛骨可以稍稍向前滑开。

steps.en: Breathe out and draw your elbows back and out. Let your shoulder blades move together without lifting your chest off the pad.
steps.zh: 呼气，两肘向后、向外拉。肩胛骨随之向中间收，胸口不离开靠垫。

steps.en: Stop when your elbows reach about the line of your body and the dumbbells are beside your upper ribs.
steps.zh: 手肘拉到大约与身体平齐、哑铃来到胸廓上部两侧时停下。

steps.en: Pause briefly, then breathe in and lower until your arms hang again, shoulder blades sliding forward without rounding your whole back. Put the dumbbells down before you get off the bench.
steps.zh: 稍停，再吸气，慢慢放到手臂重新垂下，肩胛骨向前滑开，但整个背不要拱起。先把哑铃放下，再离开凳子。

cues.en: Chest stays on the pad; only the arms and shoulder blades move.
cues.zh: 胸口贴住靠垫，只有手臂和肩胛骨在动。

cues.en: Feel the back of the shoulder and the area between the shoulder blades working together.
cues.zh: 用力感在肩膀后侧和两块肩胛骨之间。

mistakes.en: Lifting the chest off the pad. Why: the trunk swings the weight up, so the arms are no longer doing the pulling.
mistakes.zh: 胸口离开靠垫。为什么：躯干把重量甩上来，拉的就不再是手臂了。

mistakes.en: Yanking the elbows far behind the body. Why: the extra range comes from the front of the shoulder tipping forward, not from the back of the shoulder working harder.
mistakes.zh: 猛把手肘拉到身体后方很远。为什么：多出来的幅度来自肩前部往前顶，而不是肩后部更用力。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Spreading shoulder work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把肩部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Shorten the pull if the front of the shoulder feels strained; stop if it hurts.
cautions.zh: 肩前部有被拉扯的感觉，就缩短后拉的幅度；疼就停下。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Set a single pulley at about elbow height with a D-handle and a very light weight. Stand side-on with your working arm on the side away from the column, so the cable runs across the front of your body. A small rolled towel between elbow and ribs helps keep the elbow in place.
setup.zh: 把单滑轮调到约肘高，装 D 形把手，选很轻的配重。侧身站，做动作的手臂在远离立柱的一侧，让绳索从身前横过。在肘和肋骨之间夹一小卷毛巾，有助于让手肘固定不动。

steps.en: Hold the handle with your thumb up. Stand tall, feet planted, elbow at your side and bent to about 90°.
steps.zh: 握住把手，拇指朝上。站直，双脚踩稳，手肘贴在体侧，弯成约 90°。

steps.en: Start with your forearm across the front of your stomach, as far in as is comfortable. Keep your wrist straight and your shoulder relaxed, not rolled forward.
steps.zh: 前臂先横在腹前，向内到舒服的位置为止。手腕平直，肩膀放松，不要向前扣。

steps.en: Breathe out and turn your upper arm outward, so your hand swings in an arc away from your stomach. The elbow stays where it is and your body keeps facing the same way.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向外转，手沿弧线离开腹部。手肘留在原处，身体朝向不变。

steps.en: Stop while your elbow and body are still steady and before the shoulder feels strained. The end point is a comfortable outward turn, not a set angle.
steps.zh: 手肘和身体还稳、肩膀还没有被拉扯感时就停。终点是一个舒服的外旋位置，没有固定的角度。

steps.en: Breathe in and turn back slowly along the same arc without letting the weights crash. After the last repetition, return the handle with control and change sides.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿原来的弧线慢慢转回，不让配重片砸下。最后一次做完，稳稳送回把手，再换另一侧。

cues.en: The elbow stays put; the turn happens at the shoulder.
cues.zh: 手肘不动，转动发生在肩关节。

cues.en: Turn the upper arm, not the wrist or the whole body.
cues.zh: 转的是上臂，不是手腕，也不是整个身体。

cues.en: Feel the effort behind the shoulder, never a sharp pain in the joint.
cues.zh: 用力感在肩膀后侧；关节里不应该有刺痛。

mistakes.en: Twisting the body to pull the handle. Why: the trunk turning moves the cable, so the shoulder hardly rotates.
mistakes.zh: 转身去拉把手。为什么：是躯干转动带走了绳索，肩关节几乎没有旋转。

mistakes.en: Letting the elbow drift away from your side. Why: the arm starts to lift sideways, the deltoid joins in, and the movement is no longer a pure turn of the arm.
mistakes.zh: 手肘离开体侧往外漂。为什么：手臂开始向侧面抬起，三角肌加入进来，动作不再是单纯的转动。

text.en: Use a load light enough to turn slowly and without pain, and to return under control; add load only in small steps.
text.zh: 重量要轻到能慢慢转、不疼，还能有控制地转回；之后再小步加重。

text.en: Sets do not have to go to failure to work.
text.zh: 每组不必练到力竭也有效果。

cautions.en: After a shoulder injury or operation, follow the programme your physiotherapist gives you, not this card.
cautions.zh: 肩部受过伤或做过手术，请按物理治疗师给的方案练，不要照这张卡片做。

cautions.en: Stop at pain, tingling or a feeling that the joint is slipping.
cautions.zh: 出现疼痛、发麻，或觉得关节要滑出来时，停下。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Research shows: in 10 healthy people measured with fine-wire electrodes inside the muscles, lying on the side and turning the arm out with the elbow at the side gave the highest infraspinatus and teres minor EMG of seven external-rotation exercises (62 % and 67 % of a maximal contraction).
text.zh: 研究显示：10 名健康人用插进肌肉的细针电极测量，在七种肩外旋动作里，侧卧、手肘贴体侧的外旋让冈下肌和小圆肌的肌电最高（分别是最大收缩的 62 % 和 67 %）。

text.en: Higher EMG is not proof of more growth: EMG has not been shown to predict how much a muscle grows.
text.zh: 肌电更高不等于长得更多：没有证据表明肌电能预测肌肉增长多少。

setup.en: Set a single pulley at about elbow height with a D-handle and a very light weight. Stand side-on with your working arm nearest the column, so the cable pulls your forearm outward. A small rolled towel at your elbow helps mark its place.
setup.zh: 把单滑轮调到约肘高，装 D 形把手，选很轻的配重。侧身站，做动作的手臂靠近立柱，让绳索把前臂往外拉。在肘边夹一小卷毛巾，能帮你记住手肘的位置。

steps.en: Hold the handle with your thumb up and wrist straight. Plant your feet, with your elbow at your side, bent to about 90°.
steps.zh: 握住把手，拇指朝上，手腕平直。双脚踩稳，手肘贴在体侧，弯成约 90°。

steps.en: Start with your forearm turned a little outward, only as far as the shoulder stays comfortable and steady. Your chest keeps facing forward.
steps.zh: 前臂先略向外转，幅度以肩膀舒服、稳定为准。胸口始终朝前。

steps.en: Breathe out and turn your upper arm inward, bringing your hand in an arc towards your stomach. The elbow stays in the same spot.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向内转，手沿弧线靠向腹部。手肘留在原位。

steps.en: Stop just before your stomach, without pressing the handle into it or letting your shoulder roll forward. The wrist stays straight and the elbow bend does not change.
steps.zh: 手到腹前就停，不要把把手压到肚子上，肩膀也不要往前扣。手腕保持平直，屈肘角度不变。

steps.en: Breathe in and let the cable turn your forearm back out slowly. After the last repetition, return the handle with control and change sides.
steps.zh: 吸气，让绳索带着前臂慢慢转回。最后一次做完，稳稳送回把手，再换另一侧。

cues.en: Turn around the line of the upper arm; the elbow stays by the ribs.
cues.zh: 以上臂为轴转动，手肘留在肋旁。

cues.en: A small, smooth arc with a still body.
cues.zh: 弧线小而平顺，身体不动。

mistakes.en: Dragging the elbow across the body. Why: the arm sweeps across the chest instead of turning, so it stops being a rotation.
mistakes.zh: 把手肘横拉过身体。为什么：手臂变成往胸前横扫，而不是转动。

mistakes.en: Bending the wrist to finish. Why: the hand moves while the upper-arm bone barely turns.
mistakes.zh: 最后靠弯手腕完成。为什么：手在动，肱骨却几乎没转。

text.en: Use a load light enough to turn slowly and without pain, and to return under control; add load only in small steps.
text.zh: 重量要轻到能慢慢转、不疼，还能有控制地转回；之后再小步加重。

text.en: Sets do not have to go to failure to work.
text.zh: 每组不必练到力竭也有效果。

cautions.en: Do not force the outward starting position. After a shoulder injury or operation, follow the programme your physiotherapist gives you, not this card.
cautions.zh: 起始时不要硬把前臂往外转。肩部受过伤或做过手术，请按物理治疗师给的方案练，不要照这张卡片做。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Fit a short straight bar to a high pulley and choose a light weight. Face the column and step back far enough that, with your arms raised in front, the weights still hang clear of the stack.
setup.zh: 高位滑轮装一根短直杆，选轻的配重。面对立柱，往后退到手臂在身前抬起时，配重片仍然悬空的位置。

steps.en: Grip the bar overhand, hands about shoulder-width apart. Plant your feet, soften your knees and lean forward slightly from the hips, back straight.
steps.zh: 正握直杆，握距约与肩同宽。双脚踩稳，膝盖微屈，从髋部稍向前倾，背部保持平直。

steps.en: Start with your arms raised in front, hands at about face height. Keep a small elbow bend that does not change, and your ribs over your pelvis.
steps.zh: 开始时手臂在身前抬起，手大约在脸的高度。肘部保持微屈且角度不变，胸廓叠在骨盆上。

steps.en: Breathe out and sweep your upper arms down towards your sides, carrying the bar in an arc to your thighs. Your body keeps the same lean.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向下扫回体侧，直杆沿弧线来到大腿前。身体前倾的角度不变。

steps.en: Stop with your hands near the front of your thighs. Do not push your elbows behind your body or snap them straight at the end.
steps.zh: 手到大腿前就停。不要把手肘推到身后，也不要在末端猛地伸直手肘。

steps.en: Breathe in and let your arms rise again slowly, shoulder blades moving with them. Go only as high as you can without arching your back; after the last repetition, guide the bar back before letting go.
steps.zh: 吸气，让手臂慢慢抬回，肩胛骨跟着动。只抬到腰不后弓的高度；最后一次做完，把直杆稳稳送回再松手。

cues.en: Move from the shoulders; the elbow bend never changes.
cues.zh: 动作发生在肩关节，屈肘角度始终不变。

cues.en: Feel the back of the armpit and the sides of your back working.
cues.zh: 用力感在腋窝后侧（腋后襞）和背部两侧。

mistakes.en: Bending and straightening the elbows to move the bar. Why: it turns into a pushdown at the elbow instead of a pull at the shoulder.
mistakes.zh: 靠屈伸手肘移动直杆。为什么：动作变成了伸肘下压，而不是肩关节在拉。

mistakes.en: Rocking the body forward and back. Why: the swing pulls the cable, and the shoulders move less.
mistakes.zh: 身体前后摇。为什么：是身体摆动在拉绳索，肩关节反而动得少。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Spreading shoulder work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把肩部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Do not let the cable pull your arms up into a painful range or pull you off balance.
cautions.zh: 不要让绳索把手臂拉到会疼的高度，也不要被它拉得站不稳。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

name.en: Dumbbell pullover on a flat bench

setup.en: Lie along a stable flat bench so your head, upper back and buttocks are supported. Choose a light dumbbell with fixed heads that you can hold securely with both hands under the top head; never use one with loose plates.
setup.zh: 沿着稳固的平板凳躺下，让头、上背和臀部都有支撑。选一只轻的固定式哑铃，双手能稳稳托住上端铃头的下方；铃片会松动的哑铃不要用。

steps.en: Sit on the bench holding the dumbbell close to your chest, then lie back carefully; or lie down first and have a helper pass it to you. Plant both feet.
steps.zh: 先坐在凳上，把哑铃抱在胸前，再小心躺下；也可以先躺好，请人把哑铃递给你。双脚踩稳。

steps.en: Cup the top head with both palms underneath and thumbs around the handle. Hold the dumbbell above your shoulders, elbows softly bent, head resting on the bench.
steps.zh: 双掌托住上端铃头，拇指绕住握柄。哑铃举在肩膀正上方，肘部微屈，头贴着凳面。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the dumbbell in an arc towards the space above and behind your head. The elbows may bend a little more as it goes back, to a moderate bend like the one in the sketch; the shoulders move, the ribs do not lift.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿弧线把哑铃向头顶后上方放下。哑铃往后走时，肘部可以再弯一点，到示意图里那样的适度弯曲；动的是肩关节，胸廓不要往上翻。

steps.en: Stop before your low back starts to arch or your shoulders feel stretched past a comfortable point. The arms do not need to go fully overhead, and the dumbbell does not need to drop below the bench.
steps.zh: 在下背开始弓起、或肩膀被拉得不舒服之前停下。手臂不必放到完全过头，哑铃也不必低于凳面。

steps.en: Breathe out and draw your upper arms back over your chest until the dumbbell is above your shoulders again, keeping that elbow bend so the shoulders do the work. Keep your hips and head on the bench.
steps.zh: 呼气，保持这个屈肘角度，用肩关节把上臂拉回到胸口上方，哑铃回到肩膀正上方。臀部和头始终贴着凳面。

steps.en: To finish, bring the dumbbell down to your chest, sit up (with help if needed) and put it down carefully. Never drop it behind the bench.
steps.zh: 结束时，先把哑铃收到胸前，再坐起来（需要时请人帮忙），稳稳放下。不要把哑铃往凳子后面扔。

cues.en: Move at the shoulders; on the way back up, keep the elbow bend you lowered with.
cues.zh: 动的是肩关节；拉回时保持放下时的屈肘角度。

cues.en: Use only the range your shoulders control with the ribs down.
cues.zh: 只用肩膀控制得住、胸廓不上翻的幅度。

cues.en: You may feel it in both the front and back folds of the armpit.
cues.zh: 用力感可能同时在腋窝前侧和后侧（腋前襞、腋后襞）。

mistakes.en: Arching the back to lower further. Why: the extra range comes from the spine bending back, not from the shoulders.
mistakes.zh: 弓腰让哑铃放得更低。为什么：多出来的幅度来自脊柱后弯，不是肩关节。

mistakes.en: Bending and straightening the elbows to bring the weight back. Why: the work shifts to the elbows instead of the shoulder arc.
mistakes.zh: 靠屈伸手肘把哑铃拉回来。为什么：用力转到了肘关节，不再是肩关节画弧。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Spreading shoulder work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把肩部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Check your grip before you lie back, and never hold the dumbbell over your face with a loose grip.
cautions.zh: 躺下之前先确认握稳了；握不牢时绝不要把哑铃举在脸的上方。

cautions.en: Do not force the stretch overhead; stop at shoulder or elbow pain.
cautions.zh: 不要硬追求头顶后方的拉伸幅度；肩部或肘部疼痛时停下。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
